source: Independent classification implementation informed by the published React wire tags, API and upstream tests. No upstream runtime is included; the upstream tests and MIT license retain attribution. This is source-informed work, not a clean-room claim.
scope: React 19.3.1 classification API, including current element tags, client references and ViewTransition types; actual React 19.1/MUI 7 callers.

implementation.targetScope: All published react-is symbols and predicates used by MUI and other React 19 callers.

changes: isValidElementType captures the type discriminator once instead of rereading getters.
Direct built-in predicates and isPortal avoid inspecting unrelated nested type metadata. Getter failures for required fields still propagate.
Native browser ESM, CommonJS and ESM share function identities; standalone boolean declarations do not import React or platform types.
